setting.xliffGlob: File pattern for translation XLIFF files.
setting.excludeGlob: File pattern excluded from processing. Keep generated .g.xlf files excluded.
setting.hover.enabled: Show translations when hovering over AL text. Click to open the matching XLIFF entry.
setting.treatNeedsTranslationAsMissing: Treat empty/new/needs-translation targets as missing. Preserve review states and non-empty targets without a state for human review.
setting.ai.enabled: Allow AI proposals when local translations are insufficient. Apply them only after your confirmation.
setting.debug.enabled: Write AI prompts, responses and errors to .alxliffstudio/debug/ai-debug.log. This can contain project texts; the file is excluded from Git by default.
setting.debug.performance.enabled: Write detailed operation timings and memory information to .alxliffstudio/debug/performance.log.
setting.debug.performance.slowThresholdM: Mark operations taking at least this many milliseconds as SLOW in the performance log.
setting.performance.workerThreads.enable: Parse and check very large XLIFF files in a worker thread to keep VS Code responsive.
setting.performance.workerThreads.minFil: Minimum approximate XLIFF text size in MiB for worker-thread processing.
setting.performance.workerThreads.minUni: Minimum translation-unit count for worker-thread processing.
setting.performance.documentSessionCache: Approximate memory budget in MiB for parsed XLIFF snapshots. Active editors stay cached; older background snapshots are evicted first.
setting.ai.vendor: Preferred VS Code model provider. Leave empty to allow any provider.
setting.ai.modelId: Optional exact model ID. Set it with Select AI Model.
setting.ai.batchSize: Source texts per AI translation request.
setting.ai.usage.enabled: Track AI translation usage and store statistics in the project.
setting.ai.context.enabled: Include Business Central context, developer notes, nearby entries, memory examples, placeholders and glossary terms in AI requests.
setting.ai.context.nearbyUnits: Maximum nearby entries from the same AL object supplied as AI context.
setting.ai.context.translationMemoryExam: Maximum confirmed .lng translations supplied as AI examples.
setting.ai.context.minimumMemorySimilari: Minimum similarity percentage for .lng entries supplied as AI examples. This does not accept fuzzy matches.
setting.ai.context.sameSourceContexts: Maximum other entries with the same source text supplied to clarify the AI context.
setting.ai.context.maxCharactersPerItem: Approximate maximum context characters per AI item. General context is trimmed before developer notes and generator metadata.
setting.validation.checkDuplicateIds: Warn and skip files with duplicate translation-unit IDs.
setting.validation.checkDuplicateGenerat: Warn and skip files with duplicate Xliff Generator notes.
setting.validation.checkMaxWidth: Warn when a translation exceeds its maxwidth limit.
setting.fuzzyMatch.enabled: Use similar .lng translations after developer comments and exact .lng/glossary matches. Similar matches are prepared for review.
setting.fuzzyMatch.minimumQuality: Minimum similarity percentage for a fuzzy translation-memory match.
setting.sourceChangeDetection.enabled: Compare translated entries with the matching .g.xlf and mark changed source texts as needs-l10n.
setting.provenance.enabled: Show and store translation origins such as developer notes, language maps and AI.
setting.glossary.enabled: Use the project glossary for matching translations and consistent terminology.
setting.glossary.path: Optional glossary path. The default is <AL project>/.alxliffstudio/glossary.json; a single legacy glossary is migrated automatically.
setting.quality.autoRun.enabled: Automatically check translation XLIFF files when the workspace opens or files, glossary and relevant settings change.
setting.quality.problemsNavigation.enabl: Offer a Show Translation Unit quick fix for Studio findings in the VS Code Problems view.
setting.quality.maxProblemsDiagnostics: Maximum findings per XLIFF in the VS Code Problems view. All findings remain available in the XLIFF Editor.
setting.quality.checkSourceEqualsTarget: Warn about identical source and target texts when their languages differ.
setting.quality.checkWhitespace: Warn about differences in leading or trailing whitespace.
setting.quality.checkRepeatedWhitespace: Warn about additional repeated spaces or tabs in the translation.
setting.quality.checkDeveloperComment: Warn when a translation differs from a clear developer-note suggestion for its target language.
setting.quality.checkPunctuation: Warn about missing or different final punctuation in the translation.
setting.quality.checkPlaceholderOrder: Legacy compatibility setting. Placeholder order is unrestricted.
setting.quality.checkFormattingSequences: Check actual line breaks and AL backslash line-break markers. C-style escape spellings are not checked.
setting.quality.checkLengthDeviation: Warn about unusually large differences in source and translation length.
setting.quality.checkNabResidues: Warn about malformed or stale NAB markers and notes on completed translations.
setting.quality.checkInconsistentTransla: Warn when the same source text has different translations in this XLIFF.
setting.quality.checkSharedTargets: Flag potentially suspicious identical translations of different source texts.
setting.quality.checkCopiedSourceTerms: Optionally flag English source words copied into non-English translations. Disabled by default to avoid false positives for technical terms.
